attempts.summary: Configured node1 as the three-zone OPNsense gateway. WAN is 172.16.40.254/24, LAN is 10.30.0.254/24, and DMZ is 10.20.0.254/24. Node2 serves `infraset-dmz` on DMZ port 8080; node4 can access it only through WAN port 8443; node3 can access it directly on port 8080. WAN- and DMZ-initiated LAN connections are blocked.
